title: CAM POSITION SENSOR (7M-GTE)
ocr_text:
CAM POSITION SENSOR (7M-GTE)
COMPONENTS

◆ Straight Pin
◆ O-Ring
◆ Gear

Position Sensor Housing

Packing

Dust Proof Cover

◆ Non-reusable part

REMOVAL OF CAM POSITION SENSOR

1. DISCONNECT CABLE FROM NEGATIVE TERMINAL OF BATTERY

2. DISCONNECT CAM POSITION SENSOR CONNECTOR

3. SET NO.1 CYLINDER TO TDC/COMPRESSION
(a) Remove the oil filler cap.
(b) Look through oil filler hole and turn the crankshaft clockwise until the cam nose can be seen.
